about_the_game:
Engage in battle now and rule the world!

*Real-Time Warfare: Three Kingdoms*

*Real-Time Warfare: Three Kingdoms* is a real-time strategy (RTS) war game set against the backdrop of the chaotic late Han Dynasty.

Players will engage in real-time command and tactical maneuvering on a massive sandbox map, deploying legions, controlling resources, and vying for battlefield control. Rewrite the Three Kingdoms landscape with true strategy and skill.

No turn-based restrictions, no idle progression; every battle is a real-time confrontation.

【True Real-Time Strategy: Sandbox Warfare Unfolds】

Large-scale sandbox battlefield, realistically recreating the atmosphere of historical warfare during the Three Kingdoms period.

Full-time combat with constantly changing battle situations; no stat-based dominance.

Real-time command system for complete control of troop deployment, marching, and engagements.

Equal emphasis on tactical maneuvering and battlefield control; a single mistake can change the course of the battle.

Immersive cold weapon warfare experience, recreating the rhythm of realistic military confrontation.

This is a hardcore RTS game that emphasizes real-time operation, strategic planning, and troop management.

【Fast-Paced Matches, Instant Battles】

Short match designs, perfect for experiencing high-intensity warfare in short bursts of free time.

Rapid marching and combat pace, say goodbye to long waits and repetitive development.

High-frequency combat experience, every second involves strategic choices.

Short season rotation mechanism, constantly changing battlefields, comebacks can happen at any time.

Making strategy less tedious, keeping war constantly tense.

In *Real-Time Warfare: Three Kingdoms*, victory depends solely on tactical decisions, battlefield judgment, and operational skill.

This is a fair and competitive multiplayer battlefield that truly tests players' strategic thinking and real-time reactions.

【Classic Three Kingdoms, Seasonal Refresh】

Hundreds of famous Three Kingdoms generals appear, participating in large-scale real-time wars.

Multi-faction PvP battles, experience the realistic national war environment of warring states.

Seasonal themes are continuously updated, with rules, maps, and tactical environments constantly changing.

Every match is a brand new strategic challenge, with no fixed formula to replicate.

History as the bone, strategy as the soul, every war is unique.

🎯 Core Game Features

Real-Time Strategy (RTS) Gameplay

Large-scale Sandbox Warfare

Real-time Tactical Gameplay and Battlefield Control

Fast-paced, short match design

Fair Competition, Multiplayer PvP Battles

A Three Kingdoms-themed War Strategy Game

The battlefield is open, the command is yours.

*Real-Time War: Three Kingdoms* – A true real-time war game for strategy players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win7/10
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G5400 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / Nvidia GeForce 710 / AMD Radeon HD 6450
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win7/10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 6000 / Nvidia GeForce 720 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Real-Time Warfare: Three Kingdoms is a real-time strategy (RTS) and sandbox warfare game that emphasizes real-time command, tactical gameplay, and large-scale battles. Experience true strategic combat and the art of war on the historical battlefields of the Three Kingdoms period.
